description: Query real-time web and API traffic telemetry, acquisition channel attribution (Smithery, Glama, PulseMCP, Official MCP Registry, Cursor, Claude Code, Grok Bot, n8n, Direct, X, LinkedIn, GitHub), MCP tool call volume, OAuth conversion funnel metrics, geographic distribution, and the live request stream. Use this read-only observability tool to monitor how developers and AI agents discover and invoke Nuntior in production. Returns aggregated counters, channel breakdowns, latency percentiles, and recent event logs.

eventType.description: Optional filter to restrict recent events to a specific telemetry event type (e.g. 'mcp_call', 'signup', 'checkout').

limit.description: Maximum number of recent live traffic events to return in the event stream (default: 50, max: 200).

sourceChannel.description: Optional filter by acquisition source channel slug (e.g. 'glama', 'smithery', 'pulsemcp', 'mcp-registry', 'n8n', 'grok-bot', 'cursor', 'direct').

windowHours.description: Lookback aggregation time window in hours (default: 168 hours = 7 days; use 24 for last 24 hours).

name: traffic_analytics
title: Real-Time Traffic & MCP Attribution Telemetry
